reasoning_content: The build script has `--noEmit` so it doesn't actually emit output! Let me fix both issues.

action.command: cd /workspace/project/wasd-clone && sed -i 's/"build": "tsc --noEmit || true"/"build": "tsc"/' server/package.json && sed -i 's/\/\/ tsc$/\/\/ tsc/' server/package.json && grep '"build"' server/package.json

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Fix build script", "command": "cd /workspace/project/wasd-clone && sed -i 's/\"build\": \"tsc --noEmit || true\"/\"build\": \"tsc\"/' server/package.json && sed -i 's/\\/\\/ tsc$/\\/\\/ tsc/' server/package.json && grep '\"build\"' server/package.json"}
